notes.title: Update V0.1.7448
notes.notes:
[b]Update V0.1.7448[/b]

-Less enemy spawns
-Dark places are brighter, blinding things are darker
-Made many puzzles more fair based on what players reported and what we saw in streams
-FSR frame generation now actually works (was broken before)
-XeSS fixed
-Added new puzzle behind fashion store in town (helps tutorialize fashion store better)
-Jump now jumps less if you only tap jump button slightly (hold for max height)
-Fixed wrong playtime in save slots (does not fully fix old save game times)
-More puzzle police added (you players are outrageous!)
-Added new NPC reactions based on watching people play
-Fixed "High"-achievement fake solution with gears and propeller
-Fixed critical bug with "gasmask guy puzzle" under bed
-Many other fixes and improvements everywhere to make things fairer and more enjoyable

Thanks for the big support! The countless feedback helps a lot!

notes.title: Supraworld Interview and Release date
notes.notes:
[p]John Walker played some Supraworld and interviewed me about it.
Read that here: [url="https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/news/why-first-person-metroidvania-supraworld-s-developer-is-hoping-players-will-try-to-break-his-game?lang=en-US"]Why first-person Metroidvania Supraworld’s developer is hoping players will try to break his game - Epic Games Store[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The testing of the Early Access is going really well. We have barely any bugs to speak of and everyone is having a great time.[/p][p]So far it's just Act1 (out of 4) but it seems to be much bigger than we thought. Some people get through it in 10 hours, some need up to 30 hours and there is a lot of optional stuff on top. Just so you have a rough idea.[/p][p]We're planning to release the Supraworld Early Access on 15. August 2025. I have not put that date onto the store page yet, as we are not 100% sure if we can do it, because the localisation work is not done yet. If something goes really wrong we might need to delay it for a bit. But that's the plan anyway![/p][p][/p][p]-David[/p]

notes.notes:
We're 3 years into development and we're finally close to getting the entire first act of Supraworld playable.
When that is done, we'll properly test it and go live with it in Early Access.

In this progress visualization you can roughly see where it's at:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123612/8120a6e26bc6e3ec3fb2e22fba10122cb7613381.png[/img]

For the act 1 release we also need the "Finishing" bar about 1/3 filled (that is the testing, making a trailer - which is required -  and maybe localisation).

To not miss the release of Supraworld, wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1869290/Supraworld/

notes.title: Sorry, we're slow.
notes.notes:
I know many of you are waiting for Early Access and I predicted october at some point.

We're like "we only need to do those 4 things, then act 1 is ready", but then you find problems in code you did 1-2 years ago and happen to rework it completely for performance reasons and another month went by with no real progress.
Things just take more time for it to be good.

I was also personally busy moving to a new home from june to october, which didn't help.

We're currently doing a lot of optimisation. I already have the FPS quadrupled on my machine, which is pretty cool, because I was really worried about performance for a long time, but it's getting very good now. Btw, it's not so much GPU stuff. The bottleneck is still in inefficient code running on the CPU.

Besides that, most core features are almost done. So at least development speed will dramatically increase once we've finished those fundamentals and optimised a lot.

You might also have heard about Unreal Engine 5.5 and some of the new features. We're looking forward to try those out, especially Megalights can make a big difference for us as it is currently a big problem that we cannot have many lights at the same time. It will give us so much more freedom in the world design.

I would say Early Access should definitely happen in early 2025.
Sorry to everyone waiting, but we have to make sure it's good!
See you in the next apology news post :D

-David

notes.title: Supraworld Early Access date
notes.notes:
Due to the recent daily deal and summer sale on Steam, Supraland got a lot of new friends. It had the highest player 
peak since 2020 even.
If you haven't yet, please wishlist our upcoming game Supraworld which is in the works since 2021.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1869290/Supraworld/


Then next step for Supraworld is to finish act 1 (out of 4) by the end of august. At first we will test this version privately with a few people and then expand the testing group a bit. When we think act 1 is solid, we want to release it to Early Access. That might be in october. We'll see.

We go Early Access because
- the experience from Supraland was that making the game while people are playing it to be a great advantage for feedback and motivation reasons. Seeing people play what you're making, you are being reminded why you're actually doing this and try to give people a better time instead of working on something in isolation forever.
- we also simply need the Early Access income because we're working on the game for 3 years now and production is expensive.

If you now think, if we're only finishing act 1 after 3 years, acts 2-4 will take forever: no, there is a lot done in them too, but it's just lots of loose bits that are not connected yet. You will see stuff around the Early Access area that we'll block off for now though. Some might take that as a challenge.
Most of the work on the game is independent from the acts though. It's mostly fundamental stuff of the game mechanics, performance optimisations and things like menus; nothing act specific.

Every like on this post reduces development time by 1 minute, as usual. Really.
